description: Declared mutants of camera phases, views of no camera, full-screen and depth-only passes, pass reads and the RP-3 assertion (render-pipeline declaration section 14, v8-arch-gyo2-render-a2; 判定 P1 to P9; render RD-4, RD-11, RD-12; RP-3). One per independently wrong decision (tests/common/mutation/README.md, criteria 1 to 3 and 9). The gf-, gd- and gt- mutants need a GPU (label gpu); gt-unwritten-not-asserted runs the skipped death case with --no-skip. Not added (with the reason): ui_render's pass in Overlay (no Engine module queues a PostProcess pass yet, so Overlay and PostProcess draw alike until A4's tonemapping; the phases' order is cp-phase-order-reversed); a full-screen pass's colour replaced, not blended (every test shader writes alpha 1, which blends the same); the depth format picked for drawing and sampling (every driver tried takes D32_FLOAT for both); a 3D pass's depth target of another size and a pass on a target of the wrong kind (Programmer Errors asserted, not tested: no guard against misuse, AGENTS section 3); the shader tool's --function (the tool is a separate host build; a table defined as EmbeddedShaders would not link with the Plugin's, so the test executable's link guards it). After the reviews (2026-11-27): retired rd-reads-depth-only-draws (a depth-only pass's MeshDraw has no texture), rd-depth-target-refused, rd-depth-linear-allowed and rd-depth-pixels-allowed (RenderTargetFormat and TextureFormat are two types: a Depth texture of pixels and an sRGB target cannot be written, and a Depth target takes no filter rule; design review S-2); added cp-written-not-first, rd-writes-3d-depth-dropped, gd-own-depth-sampled and the three rd-unwritten- of FirstUnwrittenRead. Not added: the depth-only pipeline key without blend (MeshDraw has no blend, so no change of one draw can split it; no count of pipelines is visible), a Depth target sampled by the nearest texel whatever its filter (the tests sample at texel centres, where linear and nearest agree).
